---
title: "F-CKE — Continuous KE, asymmetric ratchet"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 3
---

*F-CKE* (Continuous KE, asymmetric ratchet) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Introduced as one piece of a decomposition of the Signal protocol, alongside *F-secmsg* and *F-fsAEAD*.

*References:*

- Canetti et al. *Universally composable end-to-end secure messaging*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2022, volume 13508 of LNCS, 2022.
